issues.description: The problem statement text and the UML/template/solution disagree about the parameter list of messageOnMilk. In the textual requirements (lines describing Part 2) messageOnMilk is specified as messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) returning a string with the milk volume, but the UML (and the template/solution code) declares messageOnMilk() with no parameters. The template Main.java and the solution's Milkable interface and implementations follow the no-argument signature. This mismatch can confuse students about which method signature to implement and how to call it.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and unify the method signature across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement (text) to require messageOnMilk() with no parameters (and remove the volume requirement from the example), or (B) update the UML, template Main.java, the Milkable interface, and the solution implementations to use messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and adjust calls/implementations to include and format the milkVolume (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked (volume: [milkVolume]L)"). Choose one consistent signature and apply it to the UML, template code, and example usage.
